name: Monke Mellow
summary: Monke Mellow, a Gorilla Tag fangame, presents an immersive gaming experience where you can ascend to new heights in the 'Only Up' game mode, engage in exhilarating tag matches with fellow Monkes, or opt for a more laid-back experience in the casual mode. Explore a plethora of cosmetic options and even step into the exclusive realm of the YouTuber room for added excitement.
